description: Data for: Facility Location Allocation Modelling for Bio-Energy System in Anambra State of Nigeria: Integration of GIS and Location Model is a data set listed in DataCite country sweep of research-data repositories (Africa), a research data metadata index, published or maintained by Mendeley. This is data on the daily and yearly livestock waste generated from the cities in the study area. Coverage: Nigeria. The portal files it under the publisher Mendeley. Its tags are Renewable Power Plant, Agricultural Waste Management. The repository dates the deposit 2019; no later update was checked. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and electrification planning. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-dc-portal.
